description: This file defines the 'ContactController' class within the Goteo project, handling contact form interactions including displaying the contact form, processing submissions, captcha validation, spam prevention via honeypot, and email sending using templates.

classes.name: ContactController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying and processing the contact form, including validation, captcha, spam prevention, and email notification functionalities.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the display and processing of the contact form, including input validation, captcha verification, spam prevention, and sending of notification emails.

methods.name: captchaAction
methods.description: Generates and returns a captcha image, and stores its phrase in the session for later verification.
